headline: Celtics look to keep rolling tonight against the visiting Nets
morning_brew: Monday night was a total blowout at TD Garden and I am still buzzing from that 134-99 demolition of the Bulls. Seeing the C's put up that kind of scoring margin really makes you appreciate the depth of this roster, even if it is only the first week of the season. Everything was clicking on all cylinders, and when the defense is swarming like that, it reminds me of the championship-caliber basketball we saw during the Banner 18 run.

We are right back at it tonight at the Garden, hosting the Brooklyn Nets. I am not saying I expect another thirty-five point spread, but I do expect this team to stay aggressive and keep their foot on the gas. The Nets have been struggling to find their rhythm, and if we can dictate the pace from the opening tip, this is exactly the kind of game we need to bank while we are feeling good.

First tip is at seven-thirty and I have a feeling the atmosphere is going to be electric. I'm keeping my expectations tempered because it is a long season, but my neighbor Rick is already convinced we are going to see a statement defensive performance tonight. I am just hoping for a clean game, no injuries, and a win that keeps us moving up the standings. After that, we've got a little break before the next one on Friday.

trend_watch.trend: Pritchard exploded for 28 points on 10-of-16 shooting and buried seven three-pointers in the win over Chicago.
trend_watch.dans_take: The man is playing like he's auditioning for a starting spot every single night.

trend_watch.trend: Tatum stuffed the stat sheet with 23 points, seven rebounds, and six assists in just 28 minutes of action.
trend_watch.dans_take: Efficient and controlled, exactly the kind of leadership this team needs to lean on.

trend_watch.trend: Hauser was lights out from downtown, hitting three of his four attempts and finishing with a massive plus-36 rating.
trend_watch.dans_take: When the bench provides that kind of spacing, life gets a whole lot easier for the starters.

news_digest.dans_take: This whole thing is just noise; I'd rather focus on the guys who are actually in the building tonight.
